pilot.mapping_policy: pilot_lesson_map links introductory or repeated topic subsets only. A pilot session does not complete the linked full lessons, satisfy all their prerequisites, or award their outcomes automatically. Pilot sessions have their own prerequisite chain; P09 and P10 do not require completion of M04 or M05. Any required concept must be introduced inside the pilot before assessment.

status_policy.module_materials: Full materials are tracked separately from a real learner pilot. full_course_ready includes learner calibration and remains false until evidence exists.
status_policy.pilot_mapping: Ready pilot materials do not mark their linked curriculum lessons complete.
status_policy.progress: This generated manifest does not change or certify learner progress; use the local log.
status_policy.mastery: Self-checks and technical execution are evidence, not automatic professional grading.
